tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The screen behind everything. In Dark it carries a soft wallpaper glow; Light is for bright rooms only.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent widget fill over ground, always with a background blur of about 40px. Weather, calendar, home, now playing.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid sheets that sit above everything: confirmations, settings, an open control. One at a time.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and icon circles for things that are off.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 1px lines between rows in a grouped list, and widget edges in Dark.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and the clock, on ground, material and surface-raised.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, units, captions, on ground, material and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Everything you can tap: primary buttons, links, selected controls. White labels on tint are set at 19px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a tint fill.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Aether's presence only: the glow orb while listening or thinking, and the line that names who is speaking. Never on buttons.

tokens.name: on
tokens.usage: A device that is on, locked or healthy, and completed steps. Always paired with a word or a checkmark.

tokens.name: light-on
tokens.usage: Icon circle fill for lights that are on, as in Apple Home.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Needs a person: a failed action, an unlocked door at night. Always with a word.

families.sans: -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Inter", system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The time, once per screen. Thin weight, like the Lock Screen.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The one sentence that matters: a question from Aether, the next event.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Widget titles, row titles, room names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Aether's replies and running text. 19px because the screen is read from across a room.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Widget headers, sentence case, in label-secondary or the widget's own colour.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its text; between a title and its footnote.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between items inside a widget; gap between widgets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Widget and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows in a grouped list, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Widgets and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon circles, the agent orb.
